message: You punched an old lady and everyone saw it. Now everyone is booing at you.
You tried to impress the sponsors, tripped over a cable, and took the hospitality tent down with you.
You called every Civic in the parking lot a Type R. The enthusiasts have formed an angry committee.
You tried to lift a Caterham to prove it was light and dropped it in front of everyone.
You answered every journalist's question with a tyre noise. The clip is now viral for all the wrong reasons.
You announced that all hot hatches are basically the same. Six owners are still explaining why you are wrong.
You auctioned off the charity raffle prize by mistake. The crowd is not amused.
You waved at the wrong parade and led the entire field into a supermarket car park.
